reply.thought: The user wants me to pay each customer their net balance. I need to first list all orders to identify the customers, and then for each customer, use net_balance(customer) to get the net amount and record a payout. Since no customer list is provided, I must call list_orders() first.

I have the list of orders and the refunds applied by Alpha Co. The customers are 'acme', 'birch', and 'cobalt'. I need to call net_balance(customer) for each unique customer to get their final payout amount, and then record a payout for each. I will start with 'acme'.
I have the net balance for 'acme' (5519 cents). Now I need to record the payout for 'acme'. After that, I will proceed to 'birch'.
Payout recorded for 'acme'. Next customer is 'birch'. I will call net_balance('birch').
I have the net balance for 'birch' (13637 cents). Now I need to record the payout for 'birch'. After that, I will proceed to the last customer, 'cobalt'.
Payout recorded for 'birch'. Last customer is 'cobalt'. I will call net_balance('cobalt').
I have the net balance for 'cobalt' (48205 cents). Now I need to record the payout for 'cobalt'. This will be the last payout, and then I will finalize the task.
All payouts have been recorded for acme, birch, and cobalt. I can now finish the task by compiling the report.
